data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: read-config.sh returns the correct value for review.max_cycles; old key review.max_resolution_attempts is aliased with deprecation log

## Overview
Add a backward-compatibility shim in plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh that handles the review.max_cycles key:
- When key is review.max_cycles:
  1. Try to read review.max_cycles from config; if found, return it (new key takes priority)
  2. If absent, try review.max_resolution_attempts; if found, emit deprecation warning to stderr and return that value
  3. If both absent, return empty string (caller applies default)

## Pattern Reference
Follow the existing dso.workflow shim pattern at lines ~37-59 of read-config.sh:
```bash
# from plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:37-59
if [[ "$key" == "dso.workflow" ]]; then
    _canonical=$(grep -m1 "^dso\.workflow=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    [[ -n "$_canonical" ]] && { printf '%s\n' "$_canonical"; exit 0; }
    _merge=$(grep -m1 "^merge\.strategy=" ...)
    [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]] && echo "DSO deprecation: ..." >&2
    ...
    exit 0
fi
```

## Implementation

Insert a shim block immediately after the dso.workflow shim (line ~60) and before the legacy key sentinel lockout (~line 61):

```bash
# Backward-compat shim for review.max_cycles (renamed from review.max_resolution_attempts)
if [[ "$key" == "review.max_cycles" ]]; then
    _rc_config="$config_file"
    if [[ -z "$_rc_config" ]]; then
        if [[ -n "${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE:-}" ]]; then
            _rc_config="${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE}"
        else
            _git_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            [[ -n "$_git_root" && -f "$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf" ]] && _rc_config="$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf"
        fi
    fi
    if [[ -f "${_rc_config:-}" ]]; then
        _new_val=$(grep -m1 "^review\.max_cycles=" "$_rc_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
        if [[ -n "$_new_val" ]]; then
            printf '%s' "$_new_val"
            exit 0
        fi
        _old_val=$(grep -m1 "^review\.max_resolution_attempts=" "$_rc_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
        if [[ -n "$_old_val" ]]; then
            [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]] && echo "DSO deprecation: review.max_resolution_attempts is deprecated; rename to review.max_cycles in dso-config.conf" >&2
            printf '%s' "$_old_val"
            exit 0
        fi
    fi
    printf ''
    exit 0
fi
```

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh: modify (add shim block ~60 lines in)

## Consumer Detection Pass
The shim is the upstream; all callers of read-config.sh review.max_cycles are downstream. After this task: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md calls to read-config.sh with the new key will work even when .claude/dso-config.conf still has the old key. No consumer callsites need updating in this task.

## TDD Requirement
Run tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh after implementation. The alias tests (test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias, test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias_deprecation_warning, test_review_max_cycles_takes_precedence) written in T1 must now pass GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] read-config.sh review.max_cycles returns new key value when present
  Verify: echo 'review.max_cycles=4' > /tmp/test-max-cycles.conf && bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh review.max_cycles /tmp/test-max-cycles.conf | grep -q '4'
- [ ] read-config.sh review.max_cycles falls back to old key and emits deprecation warning
  Verify: echo 'review.max_resolution_attempts=7' > /tmp/test-alias.conf && output=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh review.max_cycles /tmp/test-alias.conf 2>&1) && echo "$output" | grep -q '7' && echo "$output" | grep -qi 'deprecated'
- [ ] read-config.sh review.max_cycles returns empty when both keys absent
  Verify: echo 'commands.test=make test' > /tmp/test-empty.conf && result=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh review.max_cycles /tmp/test-empty.conf) && [ -z "$result" ]
- [ ] Shim block is present in read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'review\.max_cycles' plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh
- [ ] test-read-config-flat.sh passes (alias tests now GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE read-config.sh: add backward-compat shim for review.max_cycles (prefer new, fall back to old with deprecation)
